$comment: In-kind (non-cash) gifts (decision 289). Rock records a gift of stock, a vehicle, or equipment as a gift paid with the Non-Cash Asset currency type, one of Rock's shipped Non-Cash Asset Types, and a summary that says what was given. Its amount is the gift's fair value. Rock's contribution statement lists it under Non-Cash Gifts, with the summary as its description, and Rock's Giving Automation job counts it like any other gift. stock is what the largest givers and the building campaign's stock gifts give (decision 43); their giving patterns size it, so its items have no value. Each other kind comes from generated households that give, at perThousandGivingHouseholdsPerYear in each year a household gives, to the fund it names, with one of its items at a fair value in the item's range. The Cast gets only the in-kind gifts its household files design. A summary is what staff typed in the Transaction Detail block.
